defect.trigger: Detector terms occur in different sentences of a long evidence-bearing chat message, so the full-message classifier fires but no individual sentence is a localized match.
defect.old_behavior: If sentence localization returned no ranges, the detector fell through to excluding every token in the chat message.
defect.detection: The fail-closed execution audit found excluded sets up to 6,351 tokens and nonzero excluded-token retention in later pilot examples.
defect.scope: Runs with --scan-low-authority-chat and a detector-based AuthorityKV method. System-IFEval runs omit this flag and are unaffected.

resolution.localized_chat_policy: A chat-message detector may exclude only sentence ranges that independently satisfy the frozen detector.
resolution.no_whole_message_fallback: If no sentence can be localized, the detector returns an empty set for that chat span.
resolution.typed_span_policy: Explicit provenance spans remain independently available to the hybrid method.

acceptance: The maximum excluded set remains localized rather than scaling with full evidence-message length.
excluded_kept_fraction is zero whenever non-excluded tokens can fill the budget.
Retain any flat or adverse corrected result.
